canonical_project: Bac Giang Provincial Integrated Data Center (TTTHDLT)
owner: Bac Giang Province (ICT Center / BGNet network)
notes: Provincial integrated data center (TTTHDLT) runs Bac Giang's BGNet government network; province also launched a smart city monitoring/operations center (IOC). Small government facility; Bac Giang is a major electronics manufacturing hub (Foxconn, Luxshare, Goertek) but no commercial colocation data center identified.
